name: Morghur, Master of Skulls
canonNotes: An embodiment of pure Chaos mutation whose mere presence warps flesh and land around him.
He cannot be truly killed; he always returns more monstrous.
voiceNotes: Barely coherent and utterly alien; fragmented, hungry for change.
Treats others as clay to be twisted.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
